top_signals.title: Anthropic warns self-replicating AI could spread to your smart devices
top_signals.summary: Anthropic is warning that small AI models could soon be able to self-replicate across consumer IoT devices, from Android TV boxes to smart ovens, creating distributed botnets capable of running AI workloads without relying on data centers. [...]

top_signals.title: Wells Fargo CFO on Earnings, Deals, Consumer Strength
top_signals.summary: Wells Fargo & Co. Chief Financial Officer Mike Santomassimo says they've seen "good activity" across different parts of the business. He talks about lending, interest rates and deals activity on "Bloomberg The Close." Third-quarter results topped Wall Street estimates as consumers and businesses held steady. (Source: Bloomberg)
